scope: Read-only decision/source reconciliation; output-only report. No canonical, synced sources, Git, artwork or full-book archival changes.

decision_coverage.result: All 16 unique decisions cover the authorized scope. Final editorial_direction overrides discussion-history proposals.

POD-DHAGA-049.decision: ତାଳ refers to ତାଳଫଳ, the palmyra fruit, compared with a tiny sesame seed.
POD-DHAGA-049.basis: User-approved editorial choice; independent source limits remain as stated in decision.

POD-DHAGA-060.decision: ଷାଠିଆ means a sixty-year-old person. The saying mocks someone who lacks possessions or capability but boasts: an empty betel pouch represents outward show without substance.
POD-DHAGA-060.basis: Explicit user lexical clarification and supplied Odia explanation; not independently dictionary-verified.

POD-DHAGA-092.decision: Retain ଜ୍ୱାଇଁ as the user-confirmed interpretation of the uploaded four-line riddle. Preserve the broader meaning of the independently attested short saying.
POD-DHAGA-092.basis: User-supplied interpretation; not independently established as an exclusive traditional answer or universal family custom.

POD-DHAGA-123.decision: ବାରବାଟି means ବାର ବାଟି ଜମି (twelve bati of land). The saying mocks boasting about cultivating a large area without the knowledge or ability to do so.
POD-DHAGA-123.basis: Explicit user interpretation; no precise conversion of the historical land unit asserted.

POD-DHAGA-157.decision: Explain that display cannot satisfy basic needs. Do not infer that hunger or devotion itself proves hypocrisy. User also describes dependence on others and lack of work as applications; these are not literal clauses of the saying.
POD-DHAGA-157.basis: User-supplied lexical and contextual interpretation; not independently dictionary-verified.

POD-DHAGA-178.decision: Retain the supported complete-destruction meaning for the paired variant. Omit an uncertain literal explanation; no claim that its literal image has been established.
POD-DHAGA-178.basis: User-approved editorial choice; independent source limits remain as stated in decision.

POD-DHAGA-288.decision: Update interpretation and translation to descriptive syntax. Preserve attested final ଉଠ; user confirmed meaning, not an orthographic change to ଉଠେ. Do not generalize the saying into a factual claim about a community.
POD-DHAGA-288.basis: Explicit user interpretation; printed source retains ଉଠ.

POD-DHAGA-341.decision: Apply the user-authorized display correction ହଗ to ହଗୁ. Preserve original witness wording internally; do not present the correction as the printed source reading.
POD-DHAGA-341.basis: Explicit user spelling correction and interpretation.

POD-DHAGA-428.decision: Keep the broad contextual rendering of ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ମୋହିଁଲେ without asserting cooking, coating, soaking or another precise physical process. The lexical process remains unestablished; the user accepts this wording as sufficient.
POD-DHAGA-428.basis: User-approved editorial choice; independent source limits remain as stated in decision.

POD-DHAGA-474.decision: Present suspicion of innocent people as the user-confirmed explanation. Distinguish this from treating the experience of being robbed itself as a fault.
POD-DHAGA-474.basis: Explicit user confirmation of the interpretation.

POD-DHAGA-491.decision: Replace displayed କାକୁଡି ଭାଡି with user-approved କାକୁଡ଼ି ବାଡ଼ି; preserve the original uploaded wording internally. Use cucumber garden/patch rather than trellis in explanation.
POD-DHAGA-491.basis: Explicit user wording correction and interpretation.

POD-DHAGA-497.decision: Replace the broad lively/freedom-to-act interpretation with the user-confirmed spending impulse and contrast with distress in shortage.

POD-DHAGA-498.decision: Retain plenty-versus-scarcity interpretation. Preserve ସାପର ଆହାର without supplying an uncertain figurative rationale. Set aside the proposed frog/riddle reading; do not incorporate it into the collection.
POD-DHAGA-498.basis: User-approved editorial choice; independent source limits remain as stated in decision.

POD-DHAGA-516.decision: Use the user-confirmed evasive/unfulfilled-promise interpretation instead of leaving sincerity and fulfilment undecided. Preserve source wording and distinguish idiomatic meaning from added literal words.

POD-DHAGA-535.decision: Retain original କାତି spelling; use quill in the explanation and translation. Set aside the proposed nearby-versus-distant family narrative. Do not present the contextual reading as independently established dictionary equivalence.
POD-DHAGA-535.basis: User-approved editorial choice; independent source limits remain as stated in decision.

POD-DHAGA-550.decision: Use the verified book text as the proposed main version; preserve upload separately. Do not assert that the saying originated in abuse of daughters-in-law, that domestic washing is inherently degrading, or that the source proves a particular family narrative. Keep literal details distinct from interpretive implications.
POD-DHAGA-550.basis: User-approved editorial choice; independent source limits remain as stated in decision.

ଖଣ୍ଡିଆ ପଥୁରି ଧୋଇବି ନାହିଁ,

550_verification.context: Personally inspected surrounding paragraphs: electoral deception, patronage, praising leaders, and staying silent to retain a place. No daughter-in-law or domestic-abuse origin established here.
550_verification.preservation: Retain uploaded four-line wording as a separately identified variant/witness. Preserve any other independently verified variants. Do not blend book first-person opening/food line with upload second-person opening/beating line.
550_verification.literal_limit: Book final line is eating rice behind a fastened door; it does not say blows or identify a daughter-in-law.
